definition_zh: 基础；基地；垒；碱；卑鄙的；以……为基础
definition_en: the bottom support of something; a main place of operations; morally low; to found on
core_image: 金字塔最底下那层石块：一切重量压在它身上
scene: 登山队把帐篷扎在山口平地上，从这里出发冲顶。They set up a base camp at the foot of the peak.
sceneCN: 这里 base 指「基地」（第 2 个义项：行动出发的主要据点）；句意：他们在峰脚下建了基地营。

derivatives.zh: 基本的；碱性的（base 的形容词）

senses.title: The bottom on which a thing stands
senses.definition: the lowest part that supports what is above
senses.definitionCN: 承托上方之物的最底部分
senses.example: The statue stands on a marble base.
senses.exampleCN: 雕像立在大理石底座上。
senses.why: Greek basis meant a step or footing: all weight begins below.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 basis 意为「踏步、立足」：一切重量皆始于下方。

senses.title: A center of operations
senses.definition: a place from which activity is organized
senses.example: The fleet returned to its home base.
senses.why: The foundation widened into any starting place.

senses.title: A starting point of ideas
senses.definition: a principle or fact on which reasoning rests
senses.definitionCN: 推理所依据的原则或事实
senses.example: The theory has a shaky base.
senses.why: Arguments, like buildings, need ground under them.

senses.title: In baseball
senses.definition: one of the four stations a runner must touch
senses.definitionCN: 跑垒员必须触及的四个点位之一
senses.why: Each station is a fixed footing in the game.
senses.whyCN: 每个垒位都是赛场上固定的立足点。

senses.title: In chemistry
senses.example: Soap is mildly base in solution.
senses.why: Translation of Latin basis kept in science.
senses.whyCN: 科学沿用拉丁 basis 的译名。

senses.title: Morally low
senses.definitionCN: 不讲荣誉或道德原则的
senses.example: He betrayed them from base motives.
senses.exampleCN: 他出于卑劣动机背叛了他们。
senses.why: Low of position became low of character.
senses.whyCN: 地位之低转指品行之低。

senses.title: Of low quality
senses.definition: inferior, especially of metals or coin
senses.definitionCN: 品质低劣，多指金属或钱币
senses.why: Base metal lacks the nobility of gold.
senses.whyCN: 卑金属缺少黄金的「高贵」。

senses.title: The verb: to found on
senses.definition: to use something as the ground for a decision or location
senses.definitionCN: 以某事为决定或驻扎的依据
senses.example: The film is based on a true story.
senses.why: The noun made active: to give something a base.
senses.whyCN: 名词动化：给某物一个根基。

intro.en: Base as foundation comes from Latin basis, step, from Greek basis, a going or step; the moral sense of base, low, is a different word from Latin bassus, low, short.
intro.cn: 表「基础」的 base 出自拉丁 basis「步、立足」，源自希腊语；表「卑鄙」的 base 是另一个词，出自拉丁 bassus「低的、矮的」。

items.en: The root gwa- meant to go, to step.
items.cn: 词根 gwa- 意为行走、跨步。

items.en: basis meant a step, footing, foundation.
items.cn: 希腊语 basis 指步、立足、基础。

items.en: Latin kept basis for the pedestal and for mathematical ground.
items.cn: 拉丁语 basis 兼指基座与数学中的底。

items.en: A separate word bassus meant low in height or rank.
items.cn: 另一词 bassus 指身位或地位之低。

items.en: The two words met in spelling; chemistry and baseball fixed the modern uses.
items.cn: 两词在拼法上合流；化学与棒球定型现代用法。

note.en: Group one holds the two base lines and look-alikes; group two holds the support field.
note.cn: 第一组收两条 base 词线与形近词；第二组收「支撑」义场。

entries.definition: deep sound; from bassus, the low word.
the Latin form kept in academic English.
entries.definitionCN: 拉丁原形，见于学术英语。

entries.definition: to behave in a way that makes yourself seem less important
entries.definitionCN: 使谦卑；贬低自己——只是与 base 拼写相近，词源同根但语义已分化

entries.definition: the solid ground or starting basis of a thing.

normalIntro.en: English base wears two masks: Greek basis, the footing, and Latin bassus, the low.
normalIntro.cn: 英语 base 戴着两张面具：希腊 basis「立足」，拉丁 bassus「低贱」。

normal.en: Phrase: base camp at the mountain's foot.

abstract.en: Feel the weight of a building settle into its lowest course of stone.
abstract.cn: 体会整座建筑的重量沉入最底层石块。

abstract.en: Base is where the ladder must be held.
abstract.cn: base 是梯子必须抵住的那一端。

abstract.en: A base man is a building with no foundation at all.
abstract.cn: 卑劣之人是全无地基的危楼。

examples.en: The company is based in Shanghai.
examples.cn: 这家公司总部设在上海。
他的行为出于卑劣的嫉妒。

examples.en: The lamp has a heavy bronze base.
examples.cn: 这盏灯配着厚重的铜底座。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「杯石」——杯子底下垫的石头，正是底座

root: 「基础」义出希腊语 basis「步、立足」，经拉丁 basis 进入英语；「卑鄙」义为另一词，出拉丁 bassus「低的」；两词在中古英语拼写合流。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses stack like a pyramid: the footing, the camp, the argument, the base-runner, the alkali, the low character, the base metal, and the verb that grounds all things.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项如金字塔层层相叠：底座、营地、论据、垒位、碱、卑行、贱金属，以及为万物奠基的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the lowest stone that carries all the rest.
core.cn: 核心意象：承托其余一切的最底石块。

branches.en: Physical and logical ground share one footing.
Camps and stations are footings in motion.
branches.cn: 营地与垒位是移动中的立足点。

branches.en: Chemistry keeps the Greek footing in Latin dress.
branches.cn: 化学以拉丁外衣保留希腊立足点。

branches.en: Low of place becomes low of worth.
branches.cn: 位置之低化作价值之低。

branches.en: The verb hands the base to whatever needs it.
branches.cn: 动词把根基交予所需之物。

intro.en: Base breeds a wide family: foundations, chemists, and moralists all use its offspring.
intro.cn: base 子孙繁多：建筑师、化学家与道德家皆用其后裔。

latinIntro.en: Greek basis and Latin bassus feed two streams of derivatives.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 basis 与拉丁 bassus 汇成两条派生之流。
